_rule: Fixed 9-lord sequence, always in this order, wrapping indefinitely. The lord whose nakshatra the Moon occupies at birth determines the STARTING lord; the sequence then proceeds in this fixed order. The same order is used for antardasha/pratyantardasha sub-period sequencing, starting from each period's own lord.
